say.checking: One moment, let me check that date.
say.not_business_day: {day} is not a business day. The next business day is {next}. Can you pay on {next}?
say.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {deadline}. Can you pay by {deadline}?
say.past: {day} has already passed. Which day from today can you pay?
say.ask_exact: Could you tell me the exact day you can pay?
say.vague_propose_deadline: Then I can offer {deadline}, the latest date I can record. Can you pay on {deadline}?
say.error: I could not check that date. Could you tell me the exact day again?
